items.t: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
items.d: The developer of Hermes Agent raised a $90 million Series B.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 1:48 PM PDT · October 7, 2026 Image Credits: Nous Research Marina Temkin Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users Nous Research , the startup developing the open source Hermes Agent, has raised a $90 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation, confirming TechCrunch’s earlier reporting . The round was led by Robot Ventures, with participation from other backers including Nvidia, Union Square Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Samsung, and 1789 Capital, where Donald Trump Jr. is a partner. The new financing brings the three-year-old startup’s total funding to $158 million. Popular among developers and individuals, the open source Hermes Agent has been cloned more than 24 million times, driving roughly 2.5% of global AI token usage, according to the startup’s estimates. The capital will fund Nous Research’s push into the enterprise sector with “Hermes for Businesses,” allowing companies to deploy customized AI agents that can handle multi-step workflows while keeping their data private and secure. Nous was at roughly $36 million in annualized revenue by mid-September 2026 and expects to pass $100 million before the end of 2026, The Wall Street Journal reported. items.t: X expands its ‘Gametime’ sports hub beyond the NFL, starting with MLB
items.d: X is turning its NFL-focused Gametime feature into a year-round sports destination, starting with MLB and with other professional leagues to follow.
items.fullText: X is doubling down on sports, with Wednesday’s news that it’s expanding its “Gametime” feature on the social media site to go beyond tracking the NFL alone. First announced in August, NFL Gametime is X’s new project that offers a single hub for tracking live scores, getting play-by-play updates, tuning into game feeds, and more. The move wasn’t meant to be useful only to X users who like to congregate on the platform to discuss live sporting events, but to woo brands and advertisers looking to reach passionate sports fans. At Advertising Week New York, X said Gametime will become a year-round destination spanning “all professional sports.” However, that full expansion isn’t yet live as of today. Instead, X announced its second league partnership with Major League Baseball (MLB). Arriving this month, the new MLB experience will allow baseball fans to follow and engage in postseason discussions and will organize things like scores and stats, team and league content, plus news, creator content, and real-time discussions. Image Credits: X X said content from other leagues will be added soon, including the NBA. The expansion of the Gametime feature comes as X continues its efforts to win back advertisers — in this case by leveraging live sports and their highly engaged fans as a way to draw brands back to X. “In just six weeks, Gametime has evolved from a football-focused product into a scalable destination for sports, attracting strong demand across major advertisers from payments to consumer goods looking to engage highly attentive fans from the pregame conversation through the biggest moments of the game,” said SpaceXAI’s head of Global Advertising, Monique Pintarelli, in an announcement. Global tech policymakers agree to embrace AI in science
items.d: A joint statement issued by the U.S. and 15 other countries touts the technology’s potential to accelerate scientific progress.
items.fullText: EXCLUSIVE Artificial intelligence Artificial intelligence Global tech policymakers agree to embrace AI in science A joint statement issued by the U.S. and 15 other countries touts the technology’s potential to accelerate scientific progress. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 President Donald Trump speaks in the East Room of the White House on Tuesday during a lunch meeting with top executives of AI firms as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, left, and Elon Musk listen. Jacquelyn Martin / AP Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 3, 2026, 9:00 AM EDT By Jared Perlo The United States on Sunday will release a joint statement with 15 other countries describing a shared vision for a “golden age of science” that embraces the potential of artificial intelligence. The announcement is expected in Kyoto, Japan, at this year’s Science and Technology in Society Forum, an annual gathering of experts and policymakers that began in 2004. The statement, titled the “Kyoto Vision for a Golden Age of Science,” begins by recognizing science and technology’s benefits to society then goes on to encourage research that integrates artificial intelligence. (The statement calls it “super intelligence,” given President Donald Trump’s recent executive order renaming the technology.) “Super Intelligence and new ways of organizing research are opening entirely new frontiers of discovery,” reads the statement, which was seen by NBC News. “We recognize the opportunity to take advantage of these changes.” Michael Kratsios, head of the White House’s Office of Science and Technology Policy, spearheaded the vision statement, which also says the participating countries welcome the “growing field of metascience,” a term that describes the study of the scientific process itself. Tech ministers from Japan, Korea, the United Kingdom and the United Arab Emirates were among the representatives from other countries that endorsed the statement. items.fullText: 판타지의 경계를 확장하다: 삼성 스페이셜 사이니지가 도쿄게임쇼 2026에서 펼치는 캐릭터 IP와 리테일의 미래 2026/09/23 AI 요약 새로운 뉴스룸 AI 기능을 살펴보세요! 닫기 --> AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 9월 17일부터 20일까지 일본 지바현 마쿠하리 멧세(Makuhari Messe)에서 열린 도쿄게임쇼 2026(Tokyo Game Show 2026, TGS). 글로벌 게임 기업 엔씨 부스는 게임 속 캐릭터를 눈앞에서 만나는 듯한 경험을 하려는 관람객들의 발길이 이어졌다. 그 중심에는 게임의 세계관을 화면 밖으로 확장한 삼성전자의 무안경 3D 디스플레이 ‘스페이셜 사이니지(Spatial Signage)’가 있었다. 이번 행사에서 엔씨가 선보인 ‘아스트라에 오라티오(Astrae Oratio)’는 마법이 일상에 스며든 판타지 세계를 배경으로 한 신전기 서브컬처 RPG다. 삼성 스페이셜 사이니지는 독자적인 ‘3D 플레이트(3D Plate)’ 기술을 적용해 별도의 3D 안경 없이도 콘텐츠에 생생한 입체감을 선사하며, 게임 속 캐릭터와 세계관을 오프라인 전시 공간으로 확장했다. 팬덤 경험 확장… 캐릭터와의 만남을 현실 공간으로 게임 퍼블리셔와 콘텐츠 IP(Intellectual Property, 지식재산권) 보유 기업에게 오프라인 공간은 디지털 콘텐츠를 현실로 가져오는 중요한 접점이다. 엔씨는 도쿄게임쇼에서 85형과 32형 스페이셜 사이니지를 부스 입구와 대기 공간 등에 배치해 관람객이 이동하는 과정에서도 게임 속 캐릭터와 세계관을 자연스럽게 경험하도록 했다. 부스 입구에는 85형 스페이셜 사이니지로 ‘아스트라에 오라티오’ 게임의 주요 배경인 ‘특구청’ 건물 내 엘리베이터를 재현했다. 대형 디스플레이를 통해 캐릭터를 실제 사람과 가까운 크기로 표현해, 마치 게임 속 등장인물들이 현실 세계에 인사를 건네는 듯한 장면을 연출했다. ▲ ‘아스트라에 오라티오’ 부스 입구에 설치한 85형 스페이셜 사이니지는 게임 속 다양한 캐릭터가 눈 앞으로 다가오는 듯한 연출로 관람객의 이목을 끌었다. 엔씨 아스트라에 오라티오 사업실 이용수 실장은 “관람객들이 부스에 들어서는 순간부터 실제 크기의 캐릭터와 마주하고 게임 세계에 몰입하길 바랐다”면서 “서브컬처 장르에서는 캐릭터의 생동감과 현실감이 특히 중요한데, 스페이셜 사이니지가 이런 특성을 관람객에게 효과적으로 전달할 수 있다고 판단했다”고 말했다. 현장을 찾은 관람객들은 스페이셜 사이니지가 구현한 캐릭터의 크기와 입체감에 주목했다. 콘텐츠 크리에이터 카와이 코코(Kawaii CoCo) 씨는 “캐릭터가 실제로 움직이며 상호작용하는 것처럼 생생하게 느껴졌다”며 “일반 디스플레이보다 훨씬 눈에 띄고 소셜미디어에서도 근사하게 보일 것 같아, 이 장면을 촬영해 제 구독자들에게 소개하고 싶다”고 말했다. ▲ 콘텐츠 크리에이터 카와이 코코 씨는 캐릭터의 움직임이 스페이셜 사이니지를 통해 생동감 있게 전달되어 아스트라에 오라티오 부스로 눈길이 갔다고 말했다. 스페이셜 사이니지는 52mm 1 의 얇은 두께에도 불구하고 마치 화면 뒤에 별도의 공간이 있는 듯한 깊이감을 구현한 것이 특징이다. 이러한 경험은 대중에게 게임과 캐릭터의 첫인상을 전달하는 데도 효과적으로 활용될 수 있다. 관람객 다니엘 아세로(Daniel Acero) 씨는 “처음 봤을 때 스크린 화면인 줄 전혀 몰랐고, 투명한 설치물이라고 생각했다”면서 “마치 화면 뒤에 실제 공간이 있는 것처럼 깊이감이 느껴져서 놀라웠고, 이러한 방식으로 게임 캐릭터를 소개하면 게임에 대한 관심을 높이고 캐릭터의 개성을 효과적으로 전달할 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다. 관람객 동선과 대기 공간에는 32형 스페이셜 사이니지가 설치돼 부스 전반으로 캐릭터 경험을 확장했다. 32형 제품은 49.4mm의 얇은 두께로 좁은 공간에도 유연하게 설치가 가능해, 게임 체험을 기다리는 관람객을 대상으로 캐릭터와 세계관에 대한 몰입도를 유지했다. 관람객 토마스 포르티에(Tomas NVIDIA Accelerates Public Sector AI from Pilot to Production in Southeast Asia 🔗 AI is becoming a matter of national strategy, with governments looking to move from pilots to production and deliver impact at scale, while building trusted AI capabilities that reflect local languages, cultures, priorities and economic needs. NVIDIA is working to enable all nations to be AI nations — providing the technology, infrastructure, ecosystem and expertise needed to make this possible. To accelerate this transition across Southeast Asia, NVIDIA is helping nations move AI from experimentation to production-scale deployment through open models, developer tools and a broad partner ecosystem. Together, NVIDIA and its partners are focusing on four key areas: Enhancing government operations and service delivery. Developing accessible AI-powered citizen services, and empowering local businesses. Strengthening critical infrastructure and public safety. Supporting startups, developers and researchers to strengthen national AI capabilities and innovation in each country. Technology Changes, Security Fundamentals Endure The internet and cloud computing changed how software operates, while core security responsibilities endured: establish identity, control access, limit exposure and verify that protections work. AI agents introduce new capabilities — reasoning , using tools and adapting actions based on the data they encounter. Those capabilities require applying established principles to new operating conditions. This pace creates pressure. Organizations want the productivity benefits of AI while the practices to govern and secure these systems are still developing. Security Depends on the Full Agent Stack Applications depend on code, data, identities, services and infrastructure. Security depends on how those components work together — and AI agents extend that system . Models provide capabilities; harnesses organize context, tools and workflows; and runtime environments provide the infrastructure within which actions execute. Each part of that stack carries security responsibilities, and proper protection requires controls across each layer, as data, instructions and actions move through the system.
